name: Application Component
description: Represents a modular, deployable, and replaceable part of a software system that encapsulates its behaviour and data.

name: Application Service
description: Represents an explicitly defined exposed application behaviour.

name: Application Interface
description: Represents a point of access where application services are made available to a user, another application component, or a node.
notation: Rectangle with vertical bar on left

name: Business Actor
description: Represents a business entity that is capable of performing behaviour.

name: Business Process
description: Represents a sequence of business behaviours that achieves a specific result.

name: Business Service
description: Represents an explicitly defined exposed business behaviour.

name: Node
description: Represents a computational or physical resource that hosts, manipulates, or interacts with other computational or physical resources.

name: Device
description: Represents a physical IT resource upon which system software and artefacts may be stored or deployed for execution.

name: System Software
description: Represents software that provides or contributes to an environment for storing, executing, and using software or data deployed within it.

name: Artefact
description: Represents a piece of data that is used or produced in a software development process, or by deployment and operation of an IT system.
